name: messaging-send-apns-aps-alert
description: firebase-admin/messaging ApsAlert: FCM accepts title, subtitle, body, localization keys, and launchImage, while specifying locArgs, titleLocArgs, or subtitleLocArgs without its matching key fails client preflight with messaging/invalid-payload.

locArgsWithoutLocKey.message: apns.payload.aps.alert.locKey is required when specifying locArgs
locArgsWithoutLocKey.name: Error

titleLocArgsWithoutTitleLocKey.message: apns.payload.aps.alert.titleLocKey is required when specifying titleLocArgs
titleLocArgsWithoutTitleLocKey.name: Error

subtitleLocArgsWithoutSubtitleLocKey.message: apns.payload.aps.alert.subtitleLocKey is required when specifying subtitleLocArgs
subtitleLocArgsWithoutSubtitleLocKey.name: Error
